_meta.description: Every Amazon Ads ad group as it is now: campaign, name, state, default bid. Read daily from the Ads API.
caveats: One row per entity, current state, updated in place — join it to a fact table on (store_id, country_code, ad_product, <id>); it never multiplies a sum.
Archived entities are kept so old facts keep their names; an entity unseen for 400 days is removed.
state and match_type are upper-cased across SP / SB / SD — case only, never a value mapping; the rest of Amazon's object is in `attributes`.
Every change of a field is a row in rpt_ads_entity_changes.
_meta.retention_note: kept 400 days by last_seen_on; older rows are pruned

columns.note: Internal tenant scope — auto-applied from `store`; never filter on it manually.
Marketplace code (UK/US/AE/...). Auto-filtered from the store suffix on per-marketplace tables.
Which ad product: 'Sponsored Products', 'Sponsored Brands', 'Sponsored Display' (title case). One table holds them all; filter or group on it.
Ads profile id (one per marketplace) — auto-filtered from the store suffix; do not filter manually.

Row ingest timestamp (UTC). Bookkeeping, not business data. UTC instant (timestamptz). Query results show it in the store ref's marketplace local time, without an offset; a bare date in a filter is that marketplace's midnight.
